title: India vs China: who wins? 4 rounds, real data
headline: India or *China*?
description: India against China in four rounds: people, growth, income and life expectancy. Real World Bank data. Who wins round five?
source: World Bank: population, GDP growth and GDP per capita (2025), life expectancy at birth (2024), data.worldbank.org

segments.text: India versus China. Four rounds. Who wins?
People. India now has more than China.
Growth. India's economy grows much faster.
Income. China is five times richer per person.
Life. The Chinese live almost six years longer.
Two all. Who wins round five?
